mechanism_narrative: The federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is a key monetary policy indicator, and its current value is associated with positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day forward returns in > 60% of instances, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A UNRATE above 5% indicates a deteriorating labor market, which is associated with negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day forward returns in > 60% of instances where UNRATE > 5%, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: The joint condition of a falling federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) and rising industrial production (INDPRO) indicates a strengthening economy, which is associated with positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The interaction signal (FEDFUNDS decline > 0.5% and INDPRO rise > 0.5%) produces negative 20-day forward returns in > 60% of instances, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During a recession (defined by UNRATE > 5% or a decline in GDP growth), the S&P 500 forward returns are negative over the next 20 trading days due to heightened risk aversion.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day forward returns in > 60% of instances where the regime condition (UNRATE > 5% or GDPC1 decline > 0.5%) is met, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.
